checks.name: Launch bundled Chromium and connect the guided-demo studio
Exact LT1/LT2 boundaries, keyboard input, and temporary viewer state
Guided creation-style request and refinement through the real proxy
Unsupported requests preserve the authored lesson
Immediate lesson switching preserves an edit, then reload restores it
Review is local to a revision; JSON round trip starts unreviewed
Invalid JSON import keeps the current lesson intact
Duplicate creates a separate draft and Undo restores its content
PNG export downloads a nonempty 1080 × 1350 image
360 px canvas and conversation stay usable without horizontal overflow

scope: Production frontend build and pinned guided-demo backend running locally in CI. No real model calls or hosted-deployment assertions.
visualReview: Screenshots and the exported PNG are evidence for human visual review; automated checks do not establish typography or scientific quality.
initialTitle: A clearer picture of training intensity
